easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Masked Meower by discarding a card and sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Masked Meower from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Masked Meower ability.
Cast Masked Meower from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
